text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩

words.gloss_range: vocative particle opening a direct command frame
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) turns the ayah from report into direct summons. Its address-frame reaches the four imperatives that follow, so bowing, prostrating, worshipping, and doing good are heard as obligations assigned to the summoned believers. The drawn opening sound also delays the command onset, making the move from attention to action audible after the prior sovereignty statement in 22:76.

topics.headline: summons governing the command chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole imperative sequence is framed as direct address, not as detached moral description.
topics.reason: The vocative particle opens the address before the believer-identifying phrase and the coordinated imperatives.

topics.headline: sustained audible entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the address open with a sustained call before the compact commands begin.
topics.reason: The opening vocative has recitational length and occurs before the command sequence starts.

topics.headline: sovereignty becomes address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 22:76's theology turn immediately into a second-person command scene in 22:77.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence links the preceding declarative sovereignty frame with the direct vocative and imperatives here.

words.gloss_range: formal vocative mediator before the definite relative addressee

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun naming the addressed class

words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ʾayyuhā}}) is the formal hinge between the bare call and the definite class that follows. It lets the address target the recognizable group described by {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}), so the summons is not aimed at an indefinite subset. Its specialized shape also slows the opening before the class label is named.

topics.headline: bridge to a definite addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the address is grammatically prepared to summon a whole definite class.
topics.reason: The vocative construction uses this mediator before the plural relative phrase.

topics.headline: alert form slows the launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a formal pause between summons and identity, rather than a rushed move straight to the commands.
topics.reason: The fused alert element and mediator position create a marked vocative shape.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun specifying the summoned believers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) completes the vocative by specifying the addressee as the class defined by belief. The plural relative form prepares the plural imperatives, while its appositional role keeps the identity phrase inside the summons rather than starting an independent statement. The scale contracts from the cosmic frame before the ayah to a named believing community commanded into embodied action.

topics.headline: relative clause defines the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the community is defined by a prior act of belief before any command is issued.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is appositional to the vocative mediator and introduces the belief clause.

topics.headline: plural audience for plural commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the grammar set up a collective audience before the collective imperatives arrive.
topics.reason: The plural relative agrees with the later second-person plural command forms.

topics.headline: scale narrows to the believing community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the discourse narrow from universal sovereignty into a concrete community summoned to act.
topics.reason: The boundary profile licenses a transition from universal description to communal second-person address.

words.gloss_range: completed belief used as the addressee's defining premise
words.root_gloss_range: trust, security, faith, and entrusted responsibility; local Form IV selects committed belief as community identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessed Lord as the worship object later in the ayah
final success verb closing the command arc

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) makes belief the completed premise of the address, not another item in the command list. The objectless relative-clause use defines the addressees broadly as trust-committed, while the {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field keeps belief tied to security and entrusted responsibility. The word also begins an arc: the community named by trust is later directed to {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}), with 22:54 as a same-surah trust-and-submission backdrop, and the ayah closes on {{ar:تُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:tufliḥūna}}).

topics.headline: belief before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commands are addressed to people already defined by belief.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect inside the relative clause and precedes the imperative chain.

topics.headline: trust identity with security resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as trust-commitment carrying responsibility and security resonance, while the local sense remains believing.
topics.reason: The root family supports trust and security, but the local Form IV perfect in the relative clause selects belief as the surface function.

topics.headline: same collective believed and is commanded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the plural community carried from the belief label toward the final plural success verb.
topics.reason: The plural ending aligns with the later plural imperatives and final second-person plural outcome.

topics.headline: believer formula launches instruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a community-instruction formula that connects trust to worship of the Lord and to hoped-for success.
topics.reason: The recurring believer-address formula is locally followed by worship and ethical imperatives, with same-surah trust language in 22:54 as supporting context.

words.gloss_range: first plural imperative commanding bodily bowing
words.root_gloss_range: bowing, bending, and humbling; local imperative selects voluntary bodily lowering

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following prostration imperative in the posture pair

words.prose: {{ar:ٱرْكَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:irkaʿū}}) is the first imperative after the identity phrase, so it turns address into action through the body. The {{ar:ر ك ع}} ({{tr:r-k-ʿ}}) field supplies bowing and humbling, but the local Form I imperative narrows this to the addressees' own voluntary bowing. Its place before {{ar:ٱسْجُدُوا۟}} ({{tr:usjudū}}) stages descent from bending to prostration, recalling the posture pair in 22:26 as a direct command to the believers here.

topics.headline: first command after identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's action sequence begins with a direct bodily command.
topics.reason: The word is a Form I plural imperative and begins the command chain.

topics.headline: bowing with humbling resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees physical bowing carry humbling pressure, while the local command selects the ritual bodily act.
topics.reason: The root field includes abasement, but local imperative grammar makes the act voluntary and embodied.

topics.headline: staged descent with prostration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices bowing and prostration as an ordered posture pair, moving from partial lowering to full prostration.
topics.reason: The pair is coordinated locally and appears in the same-surah posture field at 22:26.

topics.headline: sharpened opening posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening action as a marked, compressed command after the prior statement about affairs returning to Allah.
topics.reason: The imperative is a relatively rare command in the posture field and begins after the prior boundary's sovereignty language.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the prostration command to the bowing command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following prostration imperative in the posture pair
preceding bowing imperative joined to prostration

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) attaches {{ar:ٱسْجُدُوا۟}} ({{tr:usjudū}}) to {{ar:ٱرْكَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:irkaʿū}}). It accumulates another obligation while preserving the ordered descent from bowing to prostration, and because it is fused to the following imperative, the second command enters as part of one continuous chain rather than as a detached sentence.

topics.headline: joined descent command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prostration added to bowing as a coordinated act, not as a replacement or explanation.
topics.reason: The conjunction links two complete plural imperatives in the posture sequence.

topics.headline: connector fused to the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the conjunction as part of the next command's entry.
topics.reason: The proclitic particle is attached directly to the following imperative.

words.root_gloss_range: prostration, still submission, and ordered alignment; local Form I selects the addressees' own prostrating act

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following prostration imperative joined by the conjunction
preceding bowing imperative joined to prostration

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْجُدُوا۟}} ({{tr:usjudū}}) deepens the posture sequence from bowing into full prostration while keeping the same imperative mood. The {{ar:س ج د}} ({{tr:s-j-d}}) field reaches beyond human ritual into cosmic alignment, with related uses for non-human submission in 16:49, 22:18, and 55:6; locally, however, the bare Form I command requires the believers' own act, not a label or place name. The sajda-recitation setting makes the command unusually performative: the reader encounters a command that can be enacted in recitation.

topics.headline: prostration deepens bowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the body commanded downward in an ordered movement from bowing to prostration.
topics.reason: The word is a second Form I plural imperative coordinated after the bowing command.

topics.headline: human prostration within wider alignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human command belongs to a wider Quranic field of ordered submission, while the local grammar commands human believers.
topics.reason: The root has broader cosmic uses, but this surface is a second-person plural human imperative.

topics.headline: action command, not identity or place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word demands performance rather than merely naming prostrators or a place of prostration.
topics.reason: The local form is a bare imperative, not a participle, place noun, or causative form.

topics.headline: recitation can enact the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prostration command is tied to recitational performance, not only semantic instruction.
topics.reason: The critical evidence marks this ayah with a sajda-recitation setting and notes the command's audible descent.

words.gloss_range: conjunction extending the command chain from posture to worship

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following worship imperative joined to the posture pair

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins {{ar:ٱعْبُدُوا۟}} ({{tr:uʿbudū}}) to the posture pair without breaking the command chain. The same connector now changes scale: it carries the listener from bowing and prostrating into comprehensive worship, and the repeated connective cadence helps the imperatives sound like a counted sequence.

topics.headline: continuity with a scale change
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship added as a broader command while remaining continuous with the posture acts.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the third imperative with the prior posture imperatives.

topics.headline: repeated connective rhythm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a rhythmic reset before the next command rather than an isolated new sentence.
topics.reason: The proclitic is fused to the worship imperative and repeats the connective pattern of the command chain.

words.gloss_range: third plural imperative commanding worship/service with an explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: worship, service, servitude, and repeated path-smoothing; local command selects worship directed to the named Lord

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: direct object of the worship imperative

words.prose: {{ar:ٱعْبُدُوا۟}} ({{tr:uʿbudū}}) broadens the command chain from postures into comprehensive service, and unlike the first two imperatives it requires the explicit object {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}). The {{ar:ع ب د}} ({{tr:ʿ-b-d}}) field gives worship the weight of service and repeated devoted practice, while the local verb-object frame makes the servant-Lord relation explicit. Against the wavering worship described earlier in 22:11, this word returns as a firm imperative.

topics.headline: worship takes a named object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence shift from objectless posture to directed worship.
topics.reason: The imperative is completed by the accusative object at word 10.

topics.headline: worship as practiced service
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees worship as direct devoted service and repeated practice, while the local command remains worship of the Lord.
topics.reason: The broader root imagery is valid, but the local Form I imperative and object select worship/service directed to word 10.

topics.headline: servant-Lord pair made local
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a major relational pair made grammatical in this clause: worship is directed to the addressees' Lord.
topics.reason: The local verb-object relation instantiates the common worship-Lord pairing.

topics.headline: wavering worship becomes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the root return from an earlier unstable worship scene in 22:11 into a decisive community imperative.
topics.reason: The same root appears earlier in 22:11 in a contrasting worship mode, while here it is a direct plural imperative.

words.gloss_range: possessed singular Lord as direct object of worship
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, nurturing, ownership, management, and staged cultivation; local noun names the addressees' one Lord

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: worship imperative governing this object
singular Lord-title inside the possessed form

words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) fixes the target of worship as the addressees' own Lord. The accusative object role keeps it attached to {{ar:ٱعْبُدُوا۟}} ({{tr:uʿbudū}}), while the second-person plural suffix makes the relation direct and communal: many addressees share one singular {{ar:رَبَّ}} ({{tr:rabb}}). The {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) field gives that title nurturing and custodial force, so worship is directed to the one who cultivates and sustains them; it also echoes the surah opening address to the Lord in 22:1 before the ayah pivots to doing good.

topics.headline: direct object of worship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of worship is grammatically fixed, not left generic or spread over the earlier posture verbs.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object of the worship imperative.

topics.headline: one Lord for the plural addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees lordship made immediate to the addressed community while remaining singular.
topics.reason: The noun is singular and definite by second-person plural possession.

topics.headline: custodial cultivation behind the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the worship target as sustaining cultivator, while the local noun still functions as the Lord-title.
topics.reason: The root field supports nurturing and management, but the local surface is the possessed noun/title.

topics.headline: Lord relation frames ethics and outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Lord relation stand before the ethical object and remain linked by the repeated plural suffix into the purpose clause.
topics.reason: The word echoes 22:1, precedes the good-action command, and shares the suffix thread with the closing purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: conjunction introducing the final ethical imperative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preceding worship object before the ethical pivot
ethical object introduced after the conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) brings the fourth imperative into the same sequence and marks the major pivot from worship of {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) to doing {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرَ}} ({{tr:al-khayra}}). Because it coordinates rather than substitutes, ethical action is added alongside embodied devotion. As the third repeated connector, it also completes the cadence before the ayah moves to the outcome clause.

topics.headline: worship opens into ethical action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices doing good as an added coordinated obligation, not a replacement for worship.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final imperative with the preceding worship cluster.

topics.headline: third connective reset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the fourth command enter through the same connective rhythm that has been building the chain.
topics.reason: The proclitic conjunction attaches to the final imperative and repeats the earlier connector pattern.

words.gloss_range: fourth plural imperative: do, enact, perform, with the good as object
words.root_gloss_range: broad doing, acting, making, and verbhood; local imperative narrows general agency toward the definite good

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite good governed as the action object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱفْعَلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ifʿalū}}) is the fourth imperative, widening the ayah from named worship acts into enacted agency. The broad {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}) field could cover doing in general, but the verb is not left open: it takes {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرَ}} ({{tr:al-khayra}}) as its direct object, so agency is assigned to the believing community as morally directed production. A wider divine-action resonance from 85:16 can serve only as contrast; locally this is a human plural command to enact the good.

topics.headline: command widens into action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence expand from ritual and worship into a broad command to act.
topics.reason: The word is the fourth plural imperative and begins the ethical action beat.

topics.headline: doing receives a moral object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees general action constrained by a definite moral object.
topics.reason: The verb governs the definite object at word 13.

topics.headline: broad doing becomes direct assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a very broad action-root made concrete as a rare direct plural command.
topics.reason: The broad root field is real, but local imperative grammar and the following object narrow it to commanded enactment.

topics.headline: divine doing as distant contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can note a broader root resonance with divine doing in 85:16, while the local agent remains the addressed believers.
topics.reason: The cited parallel concerns an intensive divine description in 85:16, whereas this surface is a second-person plural human imperative.

words.gloss_range: definite abstract object: the good, beneficial and chosen good
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, better choice, benefit, and in some contexts wealth/property; local noun selects the definite moral-beneficial category

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following purpose particle introducing the success clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرَ}} ({{tr:al-khayra}}) is the object that commanded action must produce. Its definiteness makes the command more than doing some isolated good deed: it names the recognizable field of the good. The {{ar:خ ي ر}} ({{tr:kh-y-r}}) root keeps goodness tied to better choice and benefit, with wealth/property resonance supported elsewhere in 2:180 and 100:8 but locally subordinate to ethical good. Placed just before {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}), it becomes the hinge from ethical action into hoped-for success, and it recalls same-surah benefit language in 22:30 as commanded enactment here.

topics.headline: the good receives the doing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is to enact the definite category of good, not merely to admire goodness or perform an unspecified deed.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, accusative, and governed as the object of the action verb.

topics.headline: good as selected benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the good as beneficial and choice-shaped, while the local form remains a definite abstract object rather than an explicit comparison or wealth term.
topics.reason: The root field supports choice, comparative value, and wealth/property senses, but the local noun functions as the definite moral-beneficial object.

topics.headline: ethical object before outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that good action is the last commanded content before the success clause.
topics.reason: The word immediately precedes the purpose particle and is paired locally with the final success verb.

topics.headline: benefit language becomes command object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees same-surah good/benefit language from 22:30 return as something the community is commanded to do.
topics.reason: The same root appears in 22:30 for benefit/outcome and here as the direct object of commanded action.

words.gloss_range: expectative/purpose particle with second-person plural suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate of the purpose clause
second-person plural suffix carried into the purpose clause
earlier possessed Lord term sharing the plural suffix thread

words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) pivots from the four imperatives to their aimed-for outcome. In this divine-command setting, the particle carries hope, expectation, and purpose without making the result a detached maybe: the commands are oriented toward {{ar:تُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:tufliḥūna}}). Its attached {{ar:كُمْ}} ({{tr:kum}}) keeps the same addressed believers inside the closing clause, and the repeated suffix links worship of {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) with the hoped-for success under the sovereignty frame of 22:76.

topics.headline: commands turn toward outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imperative chain is not left as a bare list but is directed toward an anticipated result.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the subordinate outcome clause after the four imperatives.

topics.headline: same audience in the outcome clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressed believers carried grammatically from command reception into expected success.
topics.reason: The attached second-person plural suffix is the governed subject of the particle and the predicate follows at word 15.

topics.headline: suffix thread through worship and success
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same plural suffix bind Lord relation, purpose, and success into one audience thread.
topics.reason: The suffix repeats from word 10 to word 14 and the boundary profile connects the outcome to the prior sovereignty premise.

words.gloss_range: imperfect second-person plural predicate: you attain durable success/flourishing
words.root_gloss_range: success, prosperity, survival, endurance, and agricultural cleaving/plowing; local Form IV imperfect frames hoped-for attained flourishing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: expectative particle governing the final predicate
opening belief verb framing the same audience

words.prose: {{ar:تُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:tufliḥūna}}) is the predicate of {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) and the final word of the ayah, so all four imperatives converge on this outcome. The imperfect second-person plural form presents success as anticipated and unfolding for the same addressed believers. The {{ar:ف ل ح}} ({{tr:f-l-ḥ}}) field adds endurance, survival, and the plowing image of yield after effort; Form IV keeps that success as achieved breakthrough rather than passive luck. The word closes the arc opened by {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}), with 22:14 as a same-surah reward backdrop and this ayah making trust the entry and falah the landing.

topics.headline: anticipated unfolding success
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices success presented as the expected unfolding result of the commands, not a completed past fact.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect predicate under the preceding expectative particle.

topics.headline: success routed back to the addressed believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed from believing identity at the opening to hoped-for success at the close.
topics.reason: The second-person plural verb points to the same addressees, and the opening belief root is paired with the final success root, with 22:14 as same-surah reward context.

topics.headline: success as cultivated breakthrough
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices falah as durable yield after effort, while the local sense remains attained success in the outcome clause.
topics.reason: The root supports agricultural cleaving and endurance imagery, while Form IV imperfect locally expresses hoped-for success.

topics.headline: many commands, one landing word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the four commands converge into one final success word, making the ayah a progression rather than a loose list.
topics.reason: The final verb closes the purpose clause and the ayah after the imperative sequence.

topics.headline: sound supports breakthrough depth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing root move from lips toward depth, matching the cultivated-breakthrough imagery.
topics.reason: The critical rows make a concrete phonetic claim that coheres with the root imagery and does not alter the local parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative chain at 22:77 moves from bowing and prostrating through serving the Lord to doing the good, then ends in hoped-for flourishing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A progressive bodily descent becomes durable allegiance, then exits the ritual body as beneficial work; flourishing is the hoped-for durability of that integrated posture and practice.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent names addressees whose inward trust is to become embodied obedience.
Bending and lowering the head begins the literal downward movement.
Full lowering and submission intensify bodily descent into yieldedness.
Obedient worship converts momentary posture into sustained allegiance.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the relation governing the service.
Actually bringing a work about carries inward and bodily submission into effects.
Beneficial, sound good qualifies the effects the action must produce.
Victory, survival, and remaining in good supply the hoped-for durable outcome.

changed_reading.before: A list of separate ritual and ethical commands followed by a promise of success.
changed_reading.after: One continuous conversion of trusted assent into lowered embodiment, loyal service, beneficial agency, and durable flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of the nurturing Lord, doing the good, and falah allows the final clause to retain the root's cutting and husbandry images alongside success.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord repairs and raises by degrees; the servants answer by making beneficial effects. Falah then figures the hoped outcome as resistant ground opened and worked until it can bear lasting good.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and gradual completion make lordship an ongoing formative process.
The split mapped image of nourishment and growth exposes the cultivation latent in being raised by the Lord.
Effective making gives the cultivated recipients an active tending role.
Benefit and soundness identify the yield sought from that tending.
Splitting and opening supply the material first stage of cultivation.
The plougher who cuts earth turns flourishing into labor upon a resistant medium.
Lasting victory preserves the ordinary success sense as the cultivation's yield.

changed_reading.before: Worship and good deeds are conditions for an externally awarded success.
changed_reading.after: Divine nurture and human good-making form a cultivation circuit in which flourishing is both the opening labor and its enduring yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Those addressed as believers are immediately told to bend, submit, serve their sovereign Lord, and release good before flourishing is even possible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The securely trusting are not allowed to turn security into self-sufficiency: bowing activates a fall from wealth into need, service acknowledges ownership, and generous good redirects held advantage outward.

activation_trace.role: Security, trust, and entrustedness define the addressees' starting condition.
The branch of becoming poor after wealth makes bowing a surprising status reversal rather than posture alone.
The ownership relation strips away the servant's claim to autonomous possession.
Sovereign ownership locates security under the Lord rather than in retained status.
Generosity and gift make good the outward release of advantage.
Flourishing becomes survival in good after self-sufficiency has been relinquished.

changed_reading.before: Already secure believers add devotional acts and charity to their standing.
changed_reading.after: Belief is tested by a downward status conversion: entrusted security flourishes only when sovereignty is conceded and advantage becomes gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dormant-earth sequence supplies a material process for the focus's cultivation model: lowered earth receives, stirs, rises, sprouts, and greens. Doing good participates in preparing and tending the medium, while the Lord remains the giver of growth.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and gradual completion anchor growth in the Lord named by the focus.
The plougher's earth-opening work anchors the agricultural change in the focus's hoped-for falah.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the receptive medium of the mechanism.
Dry lifelessness marks the medium's initial incapacity and the scale of change.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first visible activation.
Increase and rising provide the growth phase after reception and stirring.
Vegetation emerging from earth gives the process an outward yield.
Fresh green growth confirms that the sequence culminates in living fruitfulness.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders dormant earth, received water, movement, swelling, and growth; 22:63 repeats the descent of water and the earth's greening.
The focus itself places doing beneficial good immediately before falah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the earth-growth sequence and falah's ploughing branch; I infer an ethical cultivation arrow from good action to prepared ground and durable yield. A live alternative is that the earth sequence functions only as resurrection evidence and does not model human action.

changed_reading.before: Falah is the successful result received after worship and good action.
changed_reading.after: Falah is also cultivated emergence: good action opens and tends resistant ground within a life-giving process whose growth comes from the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conditional worshipper settles when good arrives but turns away under trial and incurs loss. Against that sequence, 22:77 reads as training a stable allegiance in which worship and good-making continue independently of immediate gain.

activation_trace.role: Sustained obedient worship anchors the counter-model in the focus.
The same worship branch enters a conditional sequence and exposes allegiance that depends on outcome.
Received benefit is the condition that temporarily stabilizes the edge-worshipper.
Inclining away from a direction turns the edge into a mechanism of unstable orientation.
Settling and tranquility show that immediate benefit can produce only contingent stability.
Turning a thing onto its face supplies the reversal when conditions worsen.
Commercial loss frames transactional devotion as a failed exchange.

structural_cues: 22:11 binds worship, received good, temporary settling, trial, face-turning, and loss in a single conditional chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable conditional worship; I infer that 22:77's uninterrupted imperatives answer it by habituating nontransactional fidelity. A live alternative is simple contrast rather than a deliberate corrective relation.

changed_reading.before: The commands are means by which believers may obtain flourishing.
changed_reading.after: The commands dismantle outcome-dependent worship: flourishing names stable fidelity and beneficial action across gain and trial, not a bargain for favorable conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated prostration expands outward in two directions: it joins the addressees to a cosmos already lowered to God, and it locates bowing and prostration among people gathered at a purified house. The focus's body sequence is therefore both cosmic alignment and shared-space practice.

activation_trace.role: Literal bending anchors the repeated posture in the focus.
Lowering and submission anchor the model's common bodily relation.
The same lowering branch is predicated across the verse's vast created field, widening the posture's scale.
Dwelling and shelter give the repeated postures a maintained communal locus.
Removing ugliness from self and work makes purification functional preparation for worshippers.
Humble bowing identifies the human community occupying that prepared locus.
The place-of-prostration image fuses posture with the space made ready for it.

structural_cues: 22:18 distributes prostration across heavens, earth, celestial bodies, terrain, vegetation, animals, and people.
22:26 repeats bowing and prostration after the command to purify the House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated posture at cosmic and sanctuary scales; I infer that the focus calls believers to join and maintain that alignment. A live alternative keeps involuntary cosmic submission distinct from prescribed human ritual.

changed_reading.before: Bowing and prostrating are private devotional acts preceding ethical work.
changed_reading.after: They enroll the body in a creation-wide submission while making the worshipper responsible for a purified shared locus from which good action proceeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ritual passages repeatedly route provision outward to the poor, the contented, and the arriving seeker, while denying that flesh or blood itself reaches God. Thus doing the good becomes a transfer mechanism: ritual matter becomes human nourishment, expenditure, and excellent action rather than sacred consumption by God.

activation_trace.role: Effective doing anchors the demanded transfer in actual work.
Benefit and soundness make the recipients' good a criterion of action.
Feeding another converts ritual provision into direct material benefit.
Need and lack identify a concrete recipient rather than an abstract virtue.
The outward passage of wealth generalizes redistribution beyond one ritual occasion.
Contentment ensures that quiet need remains visible within the recipient field.
One who comes seeking or lodging adds the visibly arriving claimant to that field.
Reaching and attaining organize the explicit contrast over what does and does not reach God.
Doing what is beautiful and sound names the human agent formed by the transfer.

structural_cues: 22:28 and 22:36 repeat commands to feed named human recipients from ritual animals.
22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with the inward quality that reaches God, then names doers of excellence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies redistribution and the reach/non-reach contrast; I infer that these concretize the focus's good as benefit transferred through ritual rather than ritual material retained. A live alternative treats them as local sacrifice rules rather than a wider account of al-khayr.

changed_reading.before: Do the good is an open-ended command to virtuous conduct after worship.
changed_reading.after: Within worship, good is already material and relational: provision must leave the rite, reach differentiated human need, and form the giver as a doer of excellence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith as security becomes a public trust. Defensive power prevents the collapse of multiple worship spaces; when believers gain capacity, its proper outputs are established prayer, purifying increase, recognized good, and restraint of repellent wrong. Doing good therefore includes institutions that keep worship and social benefit possible.

activation_trace.role: Security and entrustedness anchor the public-trust reading in the focus's addressees.
Public arrangements remain answerable to actual benefit and soundness.
Driving harm away supplies protection rather than domination as power's first function.
The defended believers connect protection back to the same security-bearing identity addressed in the focus.
Repelling harm becomes a mechanism preventing the destruction that follows in the verse.
A building cast down supplies the concrete loss that defensive action averts.
The Christian worship-place branch makes protected worship explicitly broader than the addressees' own rite.
Places and houses of prayer extend the protected field across worshipping communities.
Capacity and empowerment introduce the test of what believers do with public power.
Growth and increase make obligatory giving a public circulation of flourishing.
Recognized good supplies a socially discernible norm rather than private preference.
Restraint from action supplies the blocking side of public ethical responsibility.
Repellent wrong identifies what communal restraint is directed against.

structural_cues: 22:38-40 move from defending believers to preventing demolition of several named kinds of worship space.
22:41 tests empowerment by prayer, giving, recognized good, and restraint of wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, threatened worship spaces, empowerment, and public practices; I infer that these are institutional forms of the focus's entrusted good. A live alternative reads 22:41 as signs of just rule without making them an expansion of 22:77.

changed_reading.before: Believers bow, worship, and perform individually beneficial deeds.
changed_reading.after: Secure believers carry a civic trust: protect the conditions of worship, circulate growth, and use power to sustain recognizable benefit and block recognizable harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse places full exertion beside the denial of constriction and ends with gripping God as protecting patron and helper. The focus's downward postures become a technology of dependence: demanding service is bearable because agency is attached to a preserving support rather than sealed inside the self.

activation_trace.role: Bodily bending begins the focus's relinquishment of self-standing posture.
Deep lowering makes dependence embodied rather than merely asserted.
Obedient service supplies the durable practice whose demand must be explained.
Expending one's capacity under difficulty intensifies the command sequence into sustained exertion.
Obedience and yielding identify the domain in which exertion occurs.
Constriction and tightness name precisely what is denied within that demanding domain.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies the support that keeps exertion from becoming enclosure.
A patron who takes charge gives the holding relation active governance.
Aid and making manifest supply outward help rather than isolated self-exertion.

structural_cues: 22:78 juxtaposes maximal striving, no constriction in the obedient way, holding fast to God, patronage, and aid.
Its final imperatives continue the imperative cadence begun in 22:77.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effort, denied tightness, preserving grip, patronage, and aid; I infer a causal arrow from supported dependence to nonconstricting exertion. A live alternative is that no-constriction states legal ease while striving remains a separate demand.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a demanding ascent from bodily worship to successful action.
changed_reading.after: Its demand is a supported descent into dependence: strenuous service remains spacious because worshippers hold to the patron who preserves and helps them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selection places the addressees on an inherited, repeatedly traveled way and assigns them reciprocal witness. Prayer and purifying distribution become publicly legible evidence; the focus's good is not only private benefit but a practice through which a community can truthfully be seen.

activation_trace.role: Trusted assent anchors communal witness in a claim that must become credible.
Actual effects give witness observable content rather than verbal identity alone.
Benefit and soundness constrain what can count as credible public evidence.
Choosing and drawing near establish vocation rather than self-appointment.
A road made recognizable by repeated travel turns inherited tradition into practiced continuity.
Fatherhood and upbringing give the inherited way a formative lineage.
Presence with direct observation makes witness a public relation between messenger, community, and people.
Specified worship gives the inherited witness a repeated embodied form.
Growth and increase make giving the distributive form paired with public prayer.

structural_cues: 22:78 moves from selection and Abrahamic lineage to reciprocal witness, then immediately commands prayer and giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen lineage, witness, prayer, and giving; I infer that the last two enact the witness and specify the focus's public good. A live alternative is that they are adjacent summary duties without an evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The focus addresses believers as individuals who should worship and do good.
changed_reading.after: It commissions a formed community whose embodied worship and circulating good must make inherited trust publicly witnessable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fabricated-making and deceptive-market branches of two ordinary focus words. It remains anchored in فعل, خير, and فلح and gains contextual pressure from transactional loss, false speech, removal, and tightening; downstream prose should present it only as an anti-counterfeit resonance, never as a replacement translation of تفلحون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of 'do,' 'the good,' and 'flourish' can expose the difference between genuinely beneficial action and a manufactured performance of success.

activation_trace.role: Contrived fabrication shadows doing with the possibility of a made-up performance.
Actual benefit and soundness provide the internal test that limits fabricated action.
Embellishing a sale and deceptive dealing make counterfeit flourishing a live shadow of the success clause.
Commercial loss gives outcome-dependent worship a transactional register.
Falsehood and invalid speech supply an explicit counterfeit that must be avoided.
Removal followed by replacement supplies a filtering operation on inserted material.
Tightening, perfecting, and securing provide the positive endpoint of authentication.

changed_reading.before: Perform good in order to attain success.
changed_reading.after: Perform benefit that survives authentication, because both 'doing' and apparent 'success' can be staged, embellished, or transactionally counterfeited.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is unusually mapping-distant: the packet's non-dominant فعل target meets the explicit father-root in 22:78. The shared root ID, the focus's nurturing Lord, and the inherited Abrahamic way keep it traceable; downstream prose should call it a generative or parental analogy, not claim that افعلوا lexically means fathering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory lets the command to do good carry a remote image of parent-like generation and nurture.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped image of fatherhood and nurture makes good action generative rather than episodic.
The Lord's repair and gradual upbringing supply the formative pattern such action imitates.
Explicit fatherhood and upbringing in the inherited line reactivate the focus's remote mapped branch.
The repeatedly traveled inherited path gives generative action continuity across generations.

changed_reading.after: Generate and raise durable good in others, extending a formative inheritance rather than merely accumulating isolated acts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sustained-gaze branch of سجود is peripheral to ordinary prostration, so the perceptual mechanism is surprising. It remains anchored in the commanded prostration and the context's explicit distinction between eyes and heart-perception; downstream prose should render it as an attentional resonance, not redefine the rite as a visual exercise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Prostration's branch of lowered, sustained looking can make the bodily sequence a recalibration of perception before action.

activation_trace.role: Sustained looking with lowered, quiet eyes supplies the unusual attentional posture.
Effective action makes recalibrated attention consequential rather than contemplative only.
Blindness of heart and insight relocates failed perception inward.
Heart-insight supplies the positive faculty that bodily looking alone cannot guarantee.
The heart provides the organ whose orientation the lowered gaze may discipline.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is bodily submission before the command to act.
changed_reading.after: Prostration may also quiet and lower outward seeing so inward discernment can govern what good is actually done.

strongest_changes: Falah changed from an abstract reward into cultivated emergence: earth is opened, stirred, raised, and made fruitful under divine nurture.
Doing the good became materially and publicly testable through feeding, expenditure, protection of worship spaces, and accountable use of power.
The adjacent closing verse reframed the command chain as strenuous but nonconstricting dependence and as an inherited public witness.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several mechanisms without collapsing them: bodily descent becomes action, cultivation coexists with durable victory, private worship becomes redistribution and civic protection, and distant branches preserve warnings about counterfeit success, generative action, and inward sight.
remaining_uncertainties: The ethical arrow drawn from earth revival to cultivation is abductive; resurrection remains the strongest independent function of those scenes.
Cosmic prostration and prescribed human prostration may be analogous without belonging to one operational mechanism.
The parental فعل mapping, marketplace فلح branch, and perceptual سجود branch are deliberately retained but remain too distant for unqualified prose.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Lowering unfolds into beneficial action.** `ر ك ع B001/B003` bending and humility; `س ج د B001` lowered submission; `ع ب د B003` worshipful obedience; `ر ب ب B002` nurture to completion; `ف ع ل B001` bringing an act into being; `خ ي ر B001/B005` inclined-to good and beneficence. The imperatives move from posture through relation into general action. I infer that ritual lowering trains agency to produce good beyond the ritual moment. Worship reads as an embodied generator of beneficence.
2. **Success is cultivated cleaving.** `ف ل ح B005` gives lasting success, while `B001/B003` gives splitting and the tiller who opens ground. After earth imagery throughout the surah, I infer that repeated worship and good action open resistant ground for durable growth. *Tufliḥūn* retains success while activating cultivation as its mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:78 filled the cultivation image with institutions: maintained prayer, growth-giving alms, strenuous service, testimony, and protective attachment sustain lasting good.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Vertical lowering must exit into outward good.** Fixed `ٱرْكَعُوا` activates `ر ك ع:B001` (bending and lowering), `ٱسْجُدُوا` activates `س ج د:B001` (humble lowering), and `ٱعْبُدُوا` activates `ع ب د:B003` (submissive worship) toward `ر ب ب:B001/B002` (authority and nurturing completion). The sequence then shifts to `ف ع ل:B001` (bringing an act into being) with `خ ي ر:B001` (what is inclined toward as good), aiming at `ف ل ح:B005` (success with lasting good). `22:75-76` supplied selected agency and return; `22:78` specifies struggle, prayer, almsgiving, and witness. The packet supplies bodily posture and outward act in one imperative chain; I infer that ritual lowering is meant to generate beneficial conduct. Lasting success does not arise from posture severed from action.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:78` is the decisive expansion of “do good”: effort under an anti-constriction limit, inherited naming, layered witness, prayer, almsgiving, and protective attachment make the fixed ritual-to-action sequence communal and durable.

baseline.text: Ey inananlar, rükû edin, secde edin, Rabbinize kulluk edin ve iyilik yapın ki kurtuluşa eresiniz.

findings.text: Rükû ve secdedeki dikey alçalma, Rabbe kulluktan dışarıya doğru yararlı iş yapmaya uzanmalıdır.
Kurtuluş, bir anda elde edilen payeden çok yararlı eylemle yarılıp açılan ve yetiştirilen bir sonuçtur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4 (22:58-78) - A Selected Community Becomes an Embodied Witness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Selection forms a relay whose members receive, bow, cultivate, strive, testify, and hold fast under one patron.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Witnesshood is not merely verbal. It is assembled from bodily postures, agricultural success, unobstructed exertion, inherited naming, and a graspable tether to a patron.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worship Cultivates a Field of Success
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bowing, prostration, service, and beneficial action work the ground like cultivation whose yield is survival and success.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalın çekirdeğini insanın ya da başka bir varlığın aşağı doğru eğilmesi olarak verir. Başın indirilmesi, yüzün öne çevrilmesi ve yaşlılıkta bükülmüş duruş bu fiziksel çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir; sayılabilir namaz bölümü, gönüllü boyun eğiş, yoksullaşma ve yer çukuru bu dala ait değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek bir bedensel ya da fiziksel bükülmeyi anlatır; bundan doğan ruhsal ve toplumsal çağrışımlar ayrı dallarda tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf yalın kullanımdır; tanım herhangi bir kalıba bağlı olmadan fiziksel eğilmeyi kapsar ve öteki dallardaki kalıplaşmış anlamları içine almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın veya başka bir şeyin aşağıya ya da öne doğru eğilmesi; insanda başın alçalması ve yüzün aşağı dönmesi bu durumun belirgin görünümüdür.

facets.statement: İnsan veya başka bir varlık, doğrultusunu korumayıp aşağıya ya da öne doğru bükülür.
İnsandaki gerçekleşmede baş alçalır, yüz aşağı döner ve dizler yere değse de değmese de duruş eğilmiş sayılır.
Yaşlılık yüzünden bedeni bükülmüş kişinin duruşu bu fiziksel anlamın bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtların ortak çekirdeği fiziksel eğilmedir. Başın indirilmesi, yüzün aşağı çevrilmesi ve yaşlı kişinin bükülmüş duruşu, dizlerin yere değmesini zorunlu kılmadan bu çekirdeği somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya başka bir varlıktaki gerçek fiziksel eğilmeyi, belirli bir tören ya da tutum anlamı yüklemeden karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel bükülmenin yönünü ve yalın hareket niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özellikle insanın başını ve üst gövdesini alçalttığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Başın alçalmasını ve hareketin aşağı yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan dışındaki varlıkları ve başla sınırlı olmayan genel bükülmeyi dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bütün gövdenin eğildiği insan duruşlarında kullanılır ve yaşlılık örneğine de uyar.

error_profile.preserves: Gövdenin öne doğru eğilmesini açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan dışındaki nesnelerin eğilmesini ve yalnız başın indirilmesini tam kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: eğilmek ve başını aşağı indirmek
eğilme; namazda başı ve gövdeyi öne eğme
eğilmiş veya başını aşağı indirmiş kimse
eğilmiş kimseler
eğilen kimseler

error_profile.preserves: Bedenin aşağı yönelmesini ve alçalan duruşu kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Dizlerin veya başın yere değmediği geniş eğilme alanını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.adds: Yere temas eden daha ileri ve belirli bir beden duruşu ekler.
error_profile.collision: Başka bir ibadet hareketiyle ve teslimiyet anlamıyla karışmaya yol açar.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanın bedensel olarak eğilmesi hareketini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan dışındaki eğilmeleri ve saygı amacı bulunmayan fiziksel durumları dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.adds: Harekete kaynak kanıtının zorunlu kılmadığı bir saygı amacı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ruhsal boyun eğiş dalıyla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda gerçek bir beden veya baş hareketi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gönüllü boyun eğme, kendini alçaltma ve minnet bildirme tutumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bedensel alçalma, içsel veya toplumsal boyun eğmenin görünür işareti olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği fiziksel biçim değişikliğidir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise kullukta veya başka bir ilişkide kişinin kendini alçaltmasıdır. Bir hareket ötekini gösterebilse de iki anlam birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insan dışındaki varlıkların genel eğilmesini de açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ağırlığı yüzünden bir şeyin yana veya aşağı yatmasını ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da başın veya gövdenin aşağı doğru eğilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İnsan bedeninin eğilmesi alanında iki dal güçlü biçimde örtüşür. Komşu dal başın alçaltılmasını ve ağırlıkla yatmayı öne çıkarırken odak dal, insan ve insan dışı varlıklardaki genel bükülmeyi çekirdek yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bütün gövdenin bükülmesini ve yaşlılık duruşunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başla boynun çökmesine ve gök cisimlerinin ufka inişine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Başın aşağı inmesi iki dalın en açık ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel fiziksel eğilmeyi anlatır; komşu dal baş ve boynun çöküşünü merkeze alıp ufka iniş gibi başka alçalma örneklerine yayılır. Bu nedenle yalnız baş hareketi bağlamında yaklaşırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal canlı veya cansız bir varlığın aşağı doğru bükülmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yol, vadi, akarsu ve yapı gibi çizgisel yapıların yön değiştirmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Doğrultunun bozulması ve bir yana ya da aşağı yönelme iki anlamda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aşağı doğru eğilen duruşu, komşu dal ise bir çizginin veya yapının yön değiştirip kıvrılmasını anlatır. Ortak geometrik görünüm olağan kullanımda yer değiştirmelerine yetmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın belirleyici yönü aşağı veya öne doğru bedensel eğilmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bükme, dolama, yana çevirme ve geri dönme gibi daha geniş yön değişikliklerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyin düz konumdan ayrılıp bükülmesi iki dalda da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yön değişikliğinin birçok türünü ve kıvrımlı yer biçimlerini kapsar. Odak dal ise aşağıya dönük eğilmiş duruşla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on bir komşunun tamamı değerlendirildi. En yararlı beş sınır karşılaştırması yayımlandı; başı aşağı uzatma, göğüs bölgesi, araç parçası, durum kaybı ve yer çukuru adayları ya daha uzak bir fiziksel alanı temsil ediyor ya da başka dallarla zaten daha açık biçimde ayrılıyor.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه انحناء الإنسان وغيره وخفض الرأس والانكباب والشيخ المنحني من الكبر والراكع المنحني
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست الركعة عددا من الصلاة ولا التواضع والتذلل ولا الفقر بعد الغنى ولا الهُوَّة في الأرض
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على انحناء في الإنسان وغيره (maqayis)؛ كل منحن راكع (maqayis)؛ كل شيء ينكب لوجهه فتمس ركبته الأرض أو لا تمسها بعد أن يطأطئ رأسه فهو راكع (ayn)؛ الركوع الانحناء (sihah;mufradat)؛ ركع الشيخ انحنى من الكبر (sihah)؛ فالراكع المنحني (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı yalnız öne eğilme hareketi olarak değil, ayakta durulan evreyi, ardından gelen öne eğilmeyi ve iki kez yere kapanmayı kapsayan sayılabilir namaz bölümü olarak tanımlar. Bir, iki veya üç bölüm diye sayılabilmesi de aynı kimliği doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir beden hareketini değil, belirli aşamalardan oluşan ve sayı ile ifade edilebilen bütün bir namaz bölümünü anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf yalın ve kalıba bağlı kullanımları birlikte içerir; bölüm adı yalın biçimde korunurken onu yerine getirme anlamı yalnız verilen söz öbeğiyle sınırlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: Namazda ayakta durulan bir evreyi, ardından gelen öne eğilmeyi ve iki kez yere kapanmayı birlikte kapsayan, birden çok kez sayılabilen bütünlüklü bölüm.

facets.statement: Bölüm, ayakta duruşla başlayıp öne eğilme ve iki yere kapanma aşamasıyla tamamlanan bir bütündür.
Bu bütün, namaz içinde bir, iki, üç veya daha çok bölüm olarak sayılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, adı yalnız bir eğilme hareketine değil, ayakta duruşun ardından öne eğilme ve iki yere kapanmayı içeren tam bölüme verir. Aynı bölümün sayılabilir olması kullanımın ikinci belirleyici özelliğidir.

concept_gloss.text: ayakta duruş, öne eğilme ve iki yere kapanmadan oluşan namaz bölümü
concept_gloss.applicability: Namazın iç yapısındaki tam ve sayılabilir bölümü açıklayan bağlamlarda doğal, açıklayıcı bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bölümün bütünlüğünü, temel aşamalarını ve namaz içindeki yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aşamaların bağlamdan bilindiği ve yalnız bölüm sayısının önemli olduğu cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Namaz içindeki sayılabilir bölüm olma özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ayakta duruş, öne eğilme ve iki yere kapanmadan oluşan iç yapıyı açıkça söylemez.
error_profile.collision: Namazın başka türlü bölümlenmesiyle karışabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen kalıptaki eylemi, namazın tam bir bölümünü gerçekleştirme olarak aktaran cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bütün bir sayılabilir bölümün gerçekleştirildiğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bölümün hangi beden aşamalarından oluştuğunu tek başına belirtmez.
error_profile.collision: Namaz dışındaki genel bölüm tamamlama anlatımıyla karışabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ayakta duruş, öne eğilme ve iki yere kapanmayı kapsayan namaz bölümü
namazın bir tam bölümünü yerine getirmek

error_profile.preserves: Bölüm içinde yer alan belirgin beden hareketlerinden birini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ayakta duruşu, iki yere kapanmayı, bölüm bütünlüğünü ve sayılabilirliği dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.collision: Yalın fiziksel eğilme dalıyla karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Namaz sırasında gerçekleşen bedensel bir uygulama alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirli aşamalardan oluşan bütün ve sayılabilir bölüm yapısını silikleştirir.
error_profile.adds: Namazdaki başka tekil hareketleri de kapsayabilecek belirsiz bir alan ekler.
error_profile.collision: Bölüm adıyla tek bir hareket arasında karışıklık doğurur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal birden çok aşamadan oluşan sayılabilir bir namaz bölümüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal namazla sınırlı olmayan yalın fiziksel eğilmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Öne eğilme hareketi, odak daldaki namaz bölümünün aşamalarından biridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal tek bir fiziksel hareketi adlandırır. Odak dal ise o hareketi ayakta duruş ve iki yere kapanmayla birleştiren tam, sayılabilir bir bölümü adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal namazın dış yapısındaki sayılabilir bölümü gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin kendini alçaltan içsel ve toplumsal tutumunu gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam kulluk bağlamında ve eğilme imgesi çevresinde buluşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri törenin düzenlenmiş ve sayılabilir birimini, öteki kişinin boyun eğme ve kendini alçaltma tutumunu anlatır. Aynı bağlamda görünmeleri anlam çekirdeklerini birleştirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on iki komşunun tamamı değerlendirildi. Yalın eğilme ve boyun eğme dalları sınırı doğrudan aydınlattığı için yayımlandı; sayı adları, ölçüler, tek sefer anlatımı, büyüklük, yer çukuru ve durum kaybı adayları yalnız sayma biçimi, ses benzerliği veya uzak çağrışım taşıdığı için ilişki listesine alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اسم الركعة وهي قومة من الصلاة يتلوها الركوع والسجدتان وعدد ركعات الصلاة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس نفس الانحناء المسمى ركوعا ولا مطلق التواضع والتذلل
branches.source_phrase_ar: كل قومة من الصلاة ركعة (ayn)؛ كل قومة يتلوها الركوع والسجدتان من الصلوات كلها فهي ركعة (tahdhib)؛ ركع المصلي ركعة وركعتين وثلاث ركعات (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi alçak gönüllülük ve kendini aşağı tutmayı hem kullukta hem başka ilişkilerde kapsar; Tanrı'ya yönelme ve minnet bildirme bunun özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak anlamın yalnız fiziksel eğilme ya da yalnız törensel hareket olmadığı açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, kişinin tutum olarak kendini alçaltıp boyun eğmesidir; bedenin eğilmesi bunu gösterebilir ama tek başına bu dalı kurmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf yalın ve kalıba bağlı kullanımları birlikte içerir; genel tutum ile Tanrı'ya yönelmeyi bildiren özel söz öbeği ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kullukta ya da başka bir ilişkide kişinin kendini alçaltarak boyun eğmesi. Tanrı'ya yönelme ve minnetini bu biçimde bildirme, bu tutumun özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendini yüksek tutmayıp alçak gönüllü ve boyun eğen bir konuma yerleştirir.
Bu tutum hem kulluk bağlamında hem de kulluk dışındaki ilişkilerde gerçekleşebilir.
Tanrı'ya yönelip onun karşısında boyun eğmek, genel tutumun kulluk alanındaki özel biçimidir.
Minnet bildiren kişiye kendini alçaltarak Tanrı'ya teşekkür etmesinin söylenmesi bu kullanımın örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, kendini alçaltma ve boyun eğme çekirdeğini kullukla sınırlamaz. Tanrı'ya yönelme ve minnet bildirme örnekleri, bu geniş tutumun kulluk alanındaki belirgin gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kullukta veya başka bir ilişkide kişinin alçak gönüllü, teslim olan bir tutum aldığı genel anlamı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kendini alçaltma ile boyun eğmenin birlikte kurduğu tutum çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tanrı'ya yönelmeyi bildiren özel söz öbeğinin kulluk bağlamındaki doğal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya yönelişi ve onun karşısında kendini alçaltmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Kulluk dışındaki alçak gönüllülük ve boyun eğme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Minnet bildirme örneğinde, kişinin teşekkürünü alçalan bir tutumla göstermesini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Minnet bildirme ile kendini alçaltma bağını korur.
error_profile.loses: Minnet amacı bulunmayan genel boyun eğme ve kulluk dışı kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: alçak gönüllülük ve boyun eğme
Tanrı'ya boyun eğip yönelmek
putlara tapmayan veya Tanrı'ya minnetle boyun eğen kimse

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendini yüksek görmemesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir merci karşısında boyun eğme ve kendini aşağı konuma yerleştirme yönünü zayıflatır.
error_profile.collision: Sıradan ölçülülük ve gösterişsizlik anlamıyla karışabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Başka bir iradeye uyma yönünü sınırlı biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendini alçaltma, kulluk ve minnet bildirme boyutlarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.adds: Sözlü bir buyruğa uyma gibi kanıtta zorunlu olmayan bir koşul ekler.
error_profile.collision: Genel davranışsal uyumla ruhsal boyun eğişi birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal Tanrı'ya yönelme ve minnet bildirme örneklerini açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başı indirme, bakışı kısma, sesi ve organları sakinleştirme gibi görünür belirtileri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kendini alçaltma, boyun eğme ve içsel yumuşama iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, kullukta veya başka ilişkilerde kendini alçaltma tutumunu merkeze alır. Komşu dal bu tutuma bedensel sakinlik, düşük ses ve bakış gibi daha belirgin dış belirtiler ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kulluk, Tanrı'ya yönelme ve minnet bildirme alanlarına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal boyun eğişi özellikle güçsüz ve dirençsiz kalma görünümüyle sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kişinin kendini aşağı konuma yerleştirip direnmemesi iki anlamda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal güçsüzlük ve dirençsizlik görünümünü öne çıkarır. Odak dal ise alçak gönüllülükle boyun eğmeyi daha geniş tutar ve bunu kulluk ile minnet bağlamlarına da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kulluk dışındaki alçak gönüllü boyun eğişi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal düzenli kulluk, buyruklara uyma ve bağlılık alanını daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kulluk ederek ve uyarak boyun eğme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kulluk bağlamında kişinin kendini üstün bir merciye bağlı kılması ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği kendini alçaltan tutumdur ve kulluk dışına çıkabilir. Komşu dal ise kulluk ile buyruklara uymayı daha geniş bir davranış alanı olarak anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bedensel yere kapanmayı gerektirmeyen bir alçak gönüllülük tutumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal alnı yere koyma ve zorunlu kılınmış beden hareketini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Alçalma ve üstün bir merci karşısında boyun eğme iki dalda da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yere kapanma gibi belirli bir beden biçimini merkeze alır. Odak dalın anlamı ise beden hareketi olmadan da gerçekleşebilen alçak gönüllü boyun eğiştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin içsel veya toplumsal olarak kendini alçaltmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal amaç ve tutum aramadan yalnız fiziksel bükülmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Fiziksel eğilme, boyun eğen tutumun dışarıdan görülen işareti olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tutumu, komşu dal beden biçimini anlatır. Bir kişi eğilmeden boyun eğebilir veya boyun eğme amacı olmadan yalnızca fiziksel olarak eğilebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on bir komşunun tamamı değerlendirildi. Kendini alçaltma, kulluk, yere kapanma ve fiziksel eğilme sınırlarını en iyi gösteren beş aday yayımlandı; dinsel yolda düzenli uyma, korkulu bağlılık, sevgi kazanmak için alçalma ve yakarışta ısrar etme adayları ortak sahneye rağmen çekirdeği daha az keskinleştirdiği için dışarıda bırakıldı.
